title: What is Runway?

body.text: . Its Gen-family models create short clips from text (text-to-video) or from a still image (image-to-video). Great for B-roll, short ad clips, intros, and visuals that are hard to film for real.

example: A close-up of a coffee drop falling into a glass, slow motion, warm light, blurred background

title: Short clips, but powerful

body.text: each. The idea is to create several short shots and edit them together. Don't expect a full-length film in one clip — think in 'shots,' like filming a movie.

example:
Shot 1: a city at night from above
Shot 2: cars with light-trail tail lights
Shot 3: a neon sign close-up
